text:
tara_csm: Quick preflight update for the Vellum private deploy — running the connectivity + security checklist now, hit a few blockers, looping folks in.

mike_net: Saw packet loss in the VPN tunnel during our perf test. Can you confirm the customer CIDR and if they have NAT for outbound?

priya_prod: We use 10.240.0.0/16. Outbound NAT is enabled on our edge. We opened the egress rules for Redwood IPS (sent list via email).

mike_net: Got the CIDR. Two things: their TGW route table was missing the KMS endpoint route (no 10.240.0.0/16 -> aws-kms endpoint), and UDP 4500 sometimes gets dropped by their firewall. Need firewall team to allow ESP/UDP 4500/500 and TCP 443 to our egress ranges.

aisha_sec: Also noticed the KMS key policy they uploaded doesn't include the Redwood service principal — that prevents envelope decryption during keywrap. Sample principal they need to add: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodServiceRole`.

jonas_se: Linking runbook for reference: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/vpc-onboard (see sections: routing, KMS policy, CloudTrail forwarding).

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist for Vellum is due in 48h to keep the committed start date and avoid renewal credit impact.

tara_csm: Noted — renewal risk elevated if cutover slips past 2024-03-31. Action owners: mike_net -> network fixes; aisha_sec -> KMS policy + audit logs; jonas_se -> assist with runbook and on-call. ETA for fixes: 72h.

priya_prod: Our preferred change window is 2024-03-28 19:00-21:00 PST. Can Redwood ops be available for that window?

jonas_se: Yes, we can cover that window. I'll DM ops and post the on-call contact. Quick KMS policy snippet they can paste into the key resource policy:

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

mike_net: I applied a temporary route to the TGW and requested the customer firewall team to open UDP/4500/500 — priya can you confirm once the firewall change is live? Also please run the health endpoint below and paste output:

`curl -sS https://internal.vellum.health/check | jq .status`

priya_prod: ran it, output: `{"status":"ok","vpn":true,"kms_reachable":true}`

mike_net: Nice, routing + NAT look good from our side now.

tara_csm: Networking — green if priya's health check stays stable. Security — aisha, can you confirm KMS policy change and CloudTrail management events forwarding?

aisha_sec: I'll verify the policy after priya re-uploads the modified JSON. For CloudTrail, they need to enable management events and forward to their SIEM (we provided the S3 prefix). Will confirm within 24h.

priya_prod: One more item from our side: can Redwood automate KMS key rotation or provide a recommended rotation cadence? Our compliance asks for 90-day rotation.

aisha_sec: We support automated rotation via scheduled rekeys; I'll add a recommended policy and sample terraform snippet to the runbook.

tara_csm: Good. Capturing feedback: Priya mentioned the onboarding docs were helpful but wanted more firewall examples and an explicit checklist for change windows — action for docs team.

priya_prod: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick response.

jonas_se: I'll stay on call during the window and help with verification steps.

tara_csm: Assigning follow-ups in Asana: NETWORK-129 (mike_net), KMS-88 (aisha_sec), RUNBOOK-22 (jonas_se). Will update customer success playbook and circle back after the 72h ETA. :thumbsup:
